svg.title: Holonomy on the sphere and on the Gaussian half-plane
svg.desc: A vector parallel-transported round a coordinate rectangle with the Levi-Civita connection comes back rotated by the Gauss curvature times the enclosed area: counter-clockwise by 0.871 radians on the unit sphere, clockwise by 0.530 radians on the Gaussian manifold where K is minus one half.
svg.text: Parallel transport round a coordinate rectangle: K × area
Blue: the start. Orange: after P→Q→R→S→P,
turned by +0.871 rad = K × area, with K = 1.
x = μ/√2 (angles are true in these coordinates)
Turned by −0.530 rad = K × area, with K = −1/2.
Arrows have equal Fisher length, so they shrink toward small σ.
